title: Do not break it
caption: Keeping the book every day becomes a small game Deepak does not want to break. The founder tells his story.
linkedin_text: A ScoreMyBiz Home card shows how many days in a row the owner has recorded, this week's small challenge and his anonymous rank among similar businesses. A missed day resets the streak.

cast.deepak: Deepak, a young Indian mobile accessories shop owner with a thin moustache, in a black t-shirt with a lanyard

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a navy suit and striped tie, facing the camera in a bright mobile accessories shop with phone cases on the walls behind him, a warm smile.
scenes.vo: Hi. This is Deepak's story. He used to keep his book when he remembered.
scenes.sub: Hi. This is Deepak's story. He used to keep his book when he remembered.
scenes.title: Do not break it

scenes.clip: {deepak} behind his shop counter, glancing at an old notebook with a guilty smile, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: Some weeks he wrote every day. Some weeks, nothing.
scenes.sub: Some weeks he wrote every day. Some weeks, nothing.

scenes.clip: {deepak} reading his phone with a competitive grin, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: ScoreMyBiz counts how many days in a row he has recorded.

scenes.clip: {deepak} nodding at his phone screen, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: It sets a small challenge for the week, and tells him when he is close.

scenes.clip: {deepak} tapping his phone quickly, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: A missed day resets the streak. So he does not miss it.
